goals: avoid unnoticed OpenAI API credit exhaustion
avoid unnoticed ChatGPT Work/Codex quota exhaustion where supported
keep monitoring low-noise and independent from model calls

architecture.api_balance_authority: OpenAI native prepaid auto-reload in API Billing
architecture.work_codex: keep daily minimal gate; use reserve/credits only if account UI offers it; no scraping
architecture.notification_policy: native billing/spend alerts first; local monitor is observability only until a separately proven alert route is needed

pending_user_account_actions: inspect API Billing auto-reload controls and choose exact threshold/restore/monthly cap
inspect ChatGPT Work/Codex reserve-credit controls if offered
only if local spend telemetry is still desired: create a separate Admin API key and provision it locally
